exposure: Blood transfusion during or following delivery
cohort: Women who underwent Cesarean section at Haukeland University Hospital between 2014-2016 (cases: n=75 with surgical site infection, controls: n=148 without)
finding: In a setting of low cesarean section rates, emergency cesarean section, pregestational obesity, preexisting psychiatric conditions, and blood transfusion during or following delivery were independent risk factors for surgical site infection, while signs of infection during labor was a marginally significant risk factor.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was a significant risk factor for surgical site infection.
